15 August – Four Renaissance paintings attributed to Antonello da Messina are stolen in an overnight heist at the Regional Museum of Messina.

In August 2026, four paintings by the Renaissance artist Antonello da Messina were stolen from the Museo Regionale in Messina, Sicily. The theft occurred on the night of August 15, during the major Ferragosto holiday. This incident involved three panels from his Polittico di San Gregorio, which are among the only surviving works by the painter in his hometown. 

FINAL: Antonello da Messina.
